html:
A peace treaty made in 562 at the frontier town of Dara between Justinian of the Eastern Roman Empire and Khosrow I of Persia. It ended the Lazic War.

The envoys, led on the Roman side by Peter the Patrician, worked out a detailed text that the historian Menander Protector preserved. Persia gave up its claim to Lazica on the Black Sea. Rome agreed to pay a yearly sum of gold, paid several years in advance. Trade between the two empires was to pass only through set customs towns, Persia was to guard the Caucasus passes against nomads, and Christians in Persia were to be allowed to worship and bury their dead.

It was meant to last fifty years but held for ten. In 572 Justin II stopped the payments and backed a revolt in Persian Armenia, which began the war of 572 to 591.
sum: A peace treaty made in 562 at the frontier town of Dara between Justinian of the Eastern Roman Empire and Khosrow I of Persia. It ended the Lazic War.
